verdict.rationale: Mistral is an API-first platform. Its docs include a first-API-request quickstart, official Python and TypeScript SDKs, and API reference endpoints such as GET /v1/models. They also document API features including function calling, structured outputs, batch processing and an Agents API, and community users report driving models programmatically for JSON generation. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe got 404s at all candidate paths), and complete endpoint documentation (a community report says details on the OCR endpoint and chunking behavior are missing).
